import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import bisect
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(input[0])
    M = int(input[1])
    A = list(map(int, input[2:N+2]))
    B = list(map(int, input[N+2:]))
    A.sort(reverse=True)
    B.sort()
    swaps = 0
    for x in B:
        pos = bisect.bisect_left(A, x)
        swaps += pos
        A.insert(pos, x)
    print(swaps)

main()
